title: Fix Orthographic Grid Scroll Lod
description: Follow-up: when zooming largely on e.g. Top, parts of the grid are missing on the right — always show a clean grid covering the complete screen. Screenshot shows hard vertical cutoff.
summary: Follow-up: hard vertical grid cutoff when zooming in orthographic Top was the drei Grid plane (sized from fadeDistance) undershooting the live frustum — fade tracked camera Z, not ortho zoom. cameraGridFadeDistance now sizes from cameraGridVisibleRadius × 32 so the plane always overfills the viewport with clean corner opacity. Vitest 196 pass; verify-fade-coverage.mjs ok.
